preconditions.description: The length of the string s is between 1 and 10,000.
The integer k is between 1 and the length of s, and s is a multiple of k.

postconditions.description: The length of s is a multiple of k.

postconditions.expression: all(len(u_i) == k for u_i in substrings)
postconditions.description: Each substring u_i has a length equal to k.

postconditions.expression: all(all(u_i.count(c) == 1 for c in u_i) for u_i in substrings)
postconditions.description: Each character in each substring u_i occurs exactly once.

postconditions.expression: all(u_i == ''.join(sorted(set(t_i), key=t_i.index) for t_i in split_s(s, k)) for u_i in substrings)
postconditions.description: Each substring u_i is a subsequence of the corresponding substring t_i from s, where characters are removed to ensure each character occurs exactly once.
